subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should this PR replace current shipped systemd exit-78 supervised-lock behavior with probe-confirmed exit 0, or should current behavior remain canonical and any remaining probe gap be handled separately?
rationale: The branch changes service-manager exit semantics and gateway auth probing in a path current main has already solved differently, so automation cannot safely choose the product and upgrade contract.

options.title: Keep exit 78 canonical
options.body: Treat current main's systemd-safe exit-78 behavior as the default and ask for any remaining probe gap as a narrower follow-up.

options.title: Adopt probe semantics
options.body: Approve the exit-0 probe direction only after rebase and live proof across shared-secret, trusted-proxy, TLS, and foreign-listener cases.

options.title: Close stale branch
options.body: Close this conflicting branch if maintainers consider the shipped supervised-lock implementation the canonical fix.

recommendation.title: Keep exit 78 canonical
recommendation.body: Treat current main's systemd-safe exit-78 behavior as the default and ask for any remaining probe gap as a narrower follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the focused current-main systemd EADDRINUSE restart-loop fix and has the strongest history signal for the exit-code contract decision.
